pipeline_params.description: OrcaRouter Adaptive: embedding-augmented LinUCB on a 10-model pool. 424-d feature vector = 40-d hand-crafted (lexical n-grams + budget + LSH) + 384-d sentence-transformer embedding (all-MiniLM-L6-v2). Per-arm ridge λ=10, alpha=0.1, Sherman-Morrison rank-1 updates. Pick priors: expensive_penalty=0.1, quality_bonus=0.1, softmax_temperature=0.05.
